message:
layers/sctp: bound chunk sub-decoders and parameters

GHSA-358w-w75h-x6rx. The v1.7.1 hardening (#163) bounded the SCTP chunk
dispatcher but not the per-type decoders behind it. INIT, INIT-ACK, SACK
and SHUTDOWN read fixed fields past a short chunk, SACK looped on
attacker-supplied counts, and decodeSCTPParameter sliced with an
unchecked TLV length. One crafted chunk panicked.

Each sub-decoder now checks its chunk type's minimum length, SACK
rejects counts the chunk can't hold, and parameters must fit their
buffer.

Also fixes a panic on valid input: chunk length excludes the last
parameter's padding (RFC 9260 3.2), so skipping a padded final
parameter sliced past the end.
